title: NIST WebBook: Sodium hydroxide is HNaO, molecular weight 39.9971 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sodium hydroxide as HNaO, molecular weight 39.9971 amu, CAS 1310-73-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sodium hydroxide, CAS Registry Number 1310-73-2, lists molecular formula HNaO and molecular weight 39.9971 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 39.9925089325 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Na.H2O/h;1H2/q+1;/p-1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
